title: Finance Executive
jobDescription:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Finance Executive – Accounts Payable (AP) to manage vendor payments, invoice processing, reconciliations, and AP-related compliance activities. The ideal candidate should have strong accounting knowledge, experience in AP operations, and proficiency in ERP systems and MS Excel.

  • Verify, process, and record vendor invoices accurately
  • Ensure timely vendor payments and resolve payment-related queries
  • Perform vendor account reconciliations and statement matching
  • Maintain AP records, documentation, and audit support files
  • Coordinate with internal departments for invoice approvals and payment processing
  • Handle GST/TDS compliance related to vendor payments
  • Prepare AP MIS reports and aging analysis
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities
  • Ensure adherence to company policies and financial controls

Required Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong understanding of Accounts Payable processes and accounting principles
  • Good knowledge of GST, TDS, and invoice compliance
  • Proficiency in MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, basic formulas)
  • Experience with ERP/accounting software such as SAP, Oracle, Tally, or similar
  • Strong analytical and reconciliation skills
  • Good communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • High attention to detail and accuracy

Preferred Qualifications:

  • B.Com / M.Com in Finance or Accounting
  • Experience in shared services or corporate finance environment is preferred

title: Executive Assistant
jobDescription:
The Executive Assistant (EA) to the CFO is a key role that provides high-level administrative support to the Chief Finance Officer. This position requires a professional and proactive individual who can effectively manage the CFO's schedule, handle confidential information, and act as a liaison between the CFO and internal/external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage active calendar of appointments; complete expense reports; compose and prepare correspondence that is sometimes confidential; arrange complex and detailed travel plans, itineraries, and agendas; and compile documents for travel-related meetings
  • Provide a bridge for smooth communication between the CXO and internal departments ,work closely and effectively with the CXO to keep him well informed of upcoming commitments and responsibilities, following up appropriately.
  • Prioritize conflicting needs; and follows-through on projects to successful completion, often with deadline pressures
  • Take care of office administrative activities, coordinate events, manage visitors
  • Plan, coordinate and ensure the CXOs schedule is followed and adhered to

Preferred candidate profile:

  • Strong organizational skills
  • Excellent communication
  • Multitasking skills
  • Stakeholder management

title: AI Engineer
jobDescription:
We at CarDekho Group are seeking a motivated and talented Junior AI Application Engineer to join our team. This role is ideal for individuals who are passionate about AI and eager to develop their skills in building and optimizing AI models, with a strong interest in data science principles. The successful candidate will contribute to the design and implementation of AI solutions, particularly in the area of Generative AI.

Key Responsibilities :

AI Expertise :

  • Assist in the design and deployment of efficient vector databases to support large-scale Generative AI projects.
  • Support the development and enhancement of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for robust information retrieval and text generation.
  • Help integrate the PydanticAI or any other Agentic frameworks and implement context-aware techniques for Generative AI models.
  • Contribute to the creation and management of human-in-the-loop workflows to ensure output accuracy, control, and bias mitigation in Generative AI applications.
  • Monitor and evaluate Generative AI model performance, assisting in addressing potential biases and fairness concerns.
  • Apply prompt engineering techniques to refine model interactions and improve the quality of outputs.

Data Science Foundation :

  • Utilize statistical and machine learning methods to analyze and prepare data for Generative AI projects.
  • Stay updated on the latest advancements in Generative AI and related fields (e.g., Natural Language Processing, Deep Learning).
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (engineering, research, product) to deliver impactful Generative AI solutions.

Qualifications:

  • Some experience or academic knowledge in building and optimizing Generative AI models (e.g., LLMs, RAG pipelines, fine-tuning).
  • Basic understanding of vector databases and their use in Generative AI.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering techniques.
  • Proficiency in Python programming and exposure to relevant AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Solid foundation in statistics, machine learning, and data analysis.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills.
  • Relevant internship experience or academic projects in AI/Data Science roles is a plus.
